messages:
maria_prod: Pushed a small prototype — ‘compact helper’ that sits as a pill at the top-right of the console for first-run guidance. Wanted quick eyes on copy, collapse behavior, and a11y before I ship to staging. screenshot: https://img.redwood/proto/compact-helper.png tom_design: Nice. First thought — the pill needs a clearer affordance for expansion. Right now it looks decorative. Suggest icon + short label, e.g., "Get started" or "Helper". Also consider a chevron that rotates on expand. jules_devex: Agree with Tom. Also: keyboard focus order — if it’s visible on page load it should be first tabbable element after main nav. If collapsed, keyboard should still be able to open it with Enter/Space. sandeep_research: Question on content surfaced in the pill: are we surfacing sample projects or just a CTA to the sample picker? We saw in the last experiment that exposing two curated samples upfront increased activation by ~12% but also added cognitive friction. maria_prod: Good call. Goal is quick wins: 1) let users pick a sample project (2 small tiles) OR 2) skip and create workspace. KPI: reduce time-to-first-run by 30% for new signups. Want the pill to expand into a mini-panel with 2 sample cards + primary CTA. tom_design: For accessibility: ensure the expand/collapse button has aria-expanded and a descriptive aria-label (e.g., "Open onboarding helper"). Also high contrast for the pill (AA at least). If we animate chevron, respect reduced-motion prefs. Example snippet: ```html
...
``` jules_devex: Nice snippet. Add a live region update when the panel opens so screen readers hear "Onboarding helper opened". Also: trap focus in the panel while it’s open, and return focus to the pill on close. ux-bot: a11y-lint results (staging branch): contrast-warning on .pill-text, missing aria-live when panel toggles, focus-trap not detected. See /a11y/reports/2623456789. maria_prod: Thanks bot. Action items: (1) Tom: update pill visuals + provide final copy options. (2) Jules: keyboard/focus flow doc + aria-live guidance. (3) Sandeep: recommend which 2 samples to surface (based on recent onboarding cohorts). I’ll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow. tom_design: Draft copy options: - Option A (explicit): "Get started — try a sample project" - Option B (compact): "Quick start" - Option C (friendly): "Try a sample" I prefer A for clarity. Thoughts? :thinking_face: sandeep_research: Leaning A too. For samples: pick "Customer-Support-Bot" and "Search-Assistant" — they map to highest activation and demo key features (chat + embedding). jules_devex: All right. I’ll draft the keyboard nav steps and a small test script for QA. Also add reduced-motion test cases. maria_prod: Great — if we can get updated visuals + aria changes by EOD then I’ll put this behind a feature flag and run a 1-week experiment. :thumbsup: tom_design: Will do. Ping me if anyone needs microcopy tweaks. :sparkles: sandeep_research: Will provide sample selection rationale doc in the thread before the sync. ux-bot: reminder: run lighthouse a11y for the flagged branch after changes. maria_prod: Thanks everyone — closing for now, will reopen with staging link.
